entities.name: Dumitru Braghiș
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dumitru Braghiș is a Moldovan politician, diplomat and economist. He was the Prime Minister of Moldova from 1999 until 2001. Then, he was a member of the Parliament of Moldova, where he represented the Party Alliance Our Moldova. He was chairman of the Party of Social Democracy and deputy in the Parliament of the Republic of Moldova (2005–2009).
